channel.title: Murtuza's Paper
channel.description: A minimal, responsive and SEO-friendly Astro blog theme.

item.title: Android Image Caching: RAM, Disk, LRU Eviction, and the Two-Level Strategy
item.description: Understand Android's two-level image cache — RAM and disk — how LRU eviction keeps it bounded, and how the memory-disk-network waterfall turns a 7-second cold load into an instant repeat load.

item.title: Why Images Load Slowly in RecyclerView and How Glide Fixes It with ViewTreeObserver
item.description: Learn why fast scrolling in a RecyclerView causes slow image loading, how thread queues get clogged by already-scrolled-past items, and how Glide uses ViewTreeObserver to cancel unwanted tasks at exactly the right moment.

item.title: Android Image Loading: OOM, Downsampling, and the Bandwidth Problem
item.description: Understand what really happens when Android loads an image — the download and decode pipeline, why large images cause OOM crashes, how downsampling fixes it, and the hidden bandwidth waste most apps accept.

item.title: Dagger 2 Fundamentals: Module, Component, Scope, and Qualifier Explained
item.description: A practical walkthrough of Dagger 2 core concepts — why it exists, how @Module, @Component, @Provides, @Inject, @Singleton, and @Qualifier work, and how compile-time code generation makes it faster than reflection-based DI.

item.title: Thread-Safe Singleton in Android: Why Double-Checked Locking Exists
item.description: Learn why naive singleton implementations break under multithreading, why synchronized alone is not enough, and how double-checked locking solves the problem correctly.

item.title: Dependency Injection vs Inversion of Control in Android: A Practical Guide
item.description: Understand the difference between Dependency Injection and Inversion of Control with a step-by-step Car, Engine, Motor example. Learn why good code means writing more lines — and why that's worth it.

item.title: How to Change FreePBX IP Address on Debian 12 - Complete Guide 2026
item.description: Step-by-step guide to safely change FreePBX IP address on Debian 12 without breaking SIP registration. Includes troubleshooting tips and firewall configuration.

item.title: How to Change FusionPBX IP Address Safely (Without Breaking SIP, RTP & FreeSWITCH)
item.description: Learn how to safely change the FusionPBX IP address without breaking SIP registration, RTP audio, or FreeSWITCH configurations. Step-by-step expert guide.

item.title: How to Remove Voicemail Menu Options in FusionPBX - Disable Options 5, 8, 9
item.description: Learn how to customize FusionPBX voicemail by removing unwanted menu options (callback, forward, save to folder). Step-by-step guide to edit FreeSWITCH XML and Lua scripts for a cleaner voicemail experience.

item.title: Flow vs Suspend in Room DAO - When to Use Which in Jetpack Compose
item.description: Learn the key differences between Flow and suspend in Room DAO. Understand when to use Flow for real-time updates and suspend for one-time operations in Jetpack Compose apps.

item.title: Install Piper TTS on Debian Linux(Offline Neural Text-to-Speech Guide)
item.description: Step-by-step guide to install and test Piper TTS on Debian Linux, including downloading an English voice model and generating speech offline.

item.title: Install Qt 6.8.0 Offline on Ubuntu
item.description: Complete step-by-step guide to install Qt 6.8.0 LTS offline on Ubuntu 24.04. Includes all dependencies, build configuration, and troubleshooting tips.

item.title: Enable TLS in FusionPBX with Let's Encrypt
item.description: Step-by-step guide to enable TLS/SSL in FusionPBX using Let's Encrypt certificates for secure SIP communication on internal and external profiles.

item.title: Android IPC: When to Use Content Provider vs AIDL
item.description: Learn the difference between Content Provider and AIDL for Android inter-process communication. Understand which to use based on your data type and communication pattern.

item.title: How Instagram Runs Smoothly: Multi-Process Architecture and C++ NDK in Android
item.description: Discover why Instagram stays smooth despite handling heavy media. Learn how Android's multi-process architecture, native C++ memory, and JNI work together to eliminate UI lag.

item.title: How to Configure FreeSWITCH ESL for External Access
item.description: Step-by-step guide to configure FreeSWITCH Event Socket Layer (ESL) for external access, including firewall rules, ACL setup.

item.title: Complete Guide to Installing Debian Linux on VirtualBox VM
item.description: Complete step-by-step guide to install Debian Linux on VirtualBox virtual machine with screenshots and post-installation configuration.

item.title: Why Reflection is Slower Than Direct Object Creation in Java
item.description: Discover why using reflection to create objects in Java is slower than direct instantiation. Learn with code examples, performance insights, and best practices for efficient Java development.

item.title: Why largeHeap Is Bad for Android Apps: Performance & Memory Explained
item.description: Learn why using the largeHeap flag in Android can cause more harm than good, and discover best practices for efficient memory management.

item.title: Why Android Apps Lag: Understanding Garbage Collection and Main Thread Performance
item.description: Learn how Android's garbage collector and main thread management impact app performance, why apps lag, and how to optimize our code for smooth UI experiences.

item.title: What Happens When an Android App Launches: Behind the Scenes of Memory Allocation
item.description: A deep dive into how Android allocates memory when an app launches, with real-world examples and a clear lifecycle diagram.

item.title: How to Visualize Dagger Dependency Graphs in Android with Scabbard
item.description: Learn how to integrate Scabbard into your Android project to visualize Dagger dependency graphs. Step-by-step guide for better dependency management.

item.title: How to Fix Android Emulator Exit Code -1073741515 (0xC0000135) on Windows
item.description: Learn how to quickly fix the Android Emulator error "Exit Code -1073741515 (0xC0000135)" on Windows by installing the Microsoft Visual C++ Redistributable.
